messages:
nina: FYI alert from cost pipeline: multi-region tag-drift hit APAC spot pool overnight. ~5,675 USD ended up `unallocated`. Looks like node-label-sync failed for ~45 nodes. Putting numbers for triage.

costbot: recon export: https://redwood.internal/costs/recon/3239998888-multiregion-drift.csv (summary attached). Window: 2026-03-23T23:40-00:20.

reza: ran session-attach heuristic using recent kube audit logs and user-session map. Proposed allocation (heuristic confidence in parens): Customer-Eng 3,200 (0.88); Platform-Playground 1,700 (0.81); Infra-Tooling 775 (0.74). Total 5,675.

tom (finance): thanks @reza. Reminder: product lead signoff required for any rebill > $1k to Playground. Also need ledger/CCs and a JIRA ticket for audit.

sam (product): Playground lead here, :thumbsup: — OK to rebill 1.7k to Platform-Playground. Please include note about using session logs as secondary attribution so audit has source.

nina: created JIRA FIN-2026-215 "APAC multi-region tag-drift - rebill 3239998888" and linked the cost export. Assigning to @reza to run rebill.

reza: rebill preview (CSV snippet):
```
project,amount,ledger,cost_center,comment
customer-eng,3200,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-CUST-ENG,"heuristic: session-attach v2"
platform-playground,1700,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-PLAYGROUND,"product lead signoff recorded"
infra-tooling,775,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-INFRA,"low-confidence heuristic"
```

ops-bot: running rebill job now. Will create JE and attach to JIRA.

costbot: JE created JE-2026-APAC-3239998888 https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-3239998888.csv. Attached to FIN-2026-215.

tom (finance): recorded. Audit note: "heuristic attribution used (session logs + kube-audit); product lead approval captured; consider automated fallback mapping if unlabeled > $500 per window."

nina: follow-up action: eng-infra to add retry on node-label-sync and an alert if unlabeled > $1k across regions. Filing infra ticket and will ping when deployed.

reza: marking rebill done; leaving thread for records.
notes: Multi-region tag drift caused unallocated GPU spend; heuristic allocation applied with product approvals; JIRA + JE created; eng follow-up scheduled
